macro_events.causal_chain: Alphabet GenAI revenue +800% YoY proves enterprise AI monetization → hyperscalers raise FY26 capex (Meta $125-145B from $115-135B) → directly feeds NVDA H200/B200/GB200 orders, AVGO custom silicon, MU HBM4, VRT/ETN power infrastructure, ANET networking, DLR/EQIX data centers → datacenter electricity demand +12% YoY → utilities (VST/CEG nuclear baseload) and gas/uranium beneficiaries → secondary effect: any company unable to articulate AI ROI gets re-rated DOWN
macro_events.geographic_dimension: US hyperscalers dominate; Greater China decoupling continues despite 145% tariffs
macro_events.historical_analog: 1996-1999 telecom capex super-cycle — peak revenue lagged peak capex by 4-6 quarters. Q3-Q4 2026 print is gating event for whether multiple expansion holds.
macro_events.counterargument: GenAI revenue dominated by Google's own ads + Workspace upsell; true enterprise SaaS AI revenue (outside MSFT Copilot) <2% at most names. If Q3 enterprise pipeline disappoints, $665B becomes balance-sheet liability.

macro_events.title: Hormuz blockade enters week 10; ~96% flow reduction; Brent $114 post-$126 spike
macro_events.causal_chain: US-Iran war started Feb 28, 2026 → dual blockade in place → only 154 vessels crossed Hormuz in March vs ~1,500 normal → 2,000 ships stranded in Gulf → war-risk insurance premiums (3.5-5%+ of hull value vs <0.05% normal) → tanker spot rates spike (FRO/INSW/DHT war-risk premium) → Asian refiners reroute via Cape of Good Hope (+12-14 days, +$2M/voyage) → Qatar LNG to Europe at risk → Dutch TTF gas elevated → US LNG export demand inflection → European industrial production headwind → EUR weakens → INR/TRY/IDR oil-importer FX under pressure → Fed gets harder data: April CPI May 12 risks 4% headline print
macro_events.geographic_dimension: Asia (Japan/Korea/India 80% Hormuz-dependent) most exposed; Europe to gas; US relative beneficiary
macro_events.historical_analog: Sep 2019 Abqaiq attack: Brent +15% in 24h, normalized in 2 weeks. THIS is structurally different — actual blockade — closer to 1973 Arab oil embargo.
macro_events.counterargument: If diplomatic off-ramp signaled this weekend (UK/France conferences ongoing), Brent could gap down $15-20 on Monday open as war-risk premium unwinds — XOM/CVX -8 to -12%.

macro_events.title: Fed pauses at 3.50-3.75% with FOUR dissents — most since 1992
macro_events.causal_chain: Wednesday FOMC held → Miran wanted CUT (one dovish dissent) → THREE dissents against the easing-bias language (hawkish bloc) → statement strengthened to 'inflation IS elevated' from 'remains somewhat elevated' → market re-prices: Fed funds futures imply ~33% chance of HIKE by April 2027 → 10Y +7bp to 4.42%, 2Y +5bp to 3.95% → curve bear-flattens → TLT $85.62 breaks toward $80 if 10Y clears 4.65% → growth stocks face DCF compression → bank NIMs widen (JPM/BAC/C/WFC tailwind) → REITs/utilities pressured → USD strength resumes
macro_events.geographic_dimension: EM FX pressure resumes (USD/JPY toward 158-160, USD/CNH toward 7.30)
macro_events.historical_analog: 1992 had 4 dissents under Greenspan; yields backed up 60bp in next 6 weeks. 4-dissent FOMC events have a 7/9 historical record of TIGHTENING by next meeting.
macro_events.counterargument: Powell's term ends May 15; Warsh confirmation likely week of May 11. Warsh skews dovish under labor-market stress. If April NFP (May 8) prints sub-100k, dissent dynamic flips entirely.
